title: Registry Study on the Multidimensional Assessment of Disease Course and Quality of Life in Patients with Epilepsy and Psychogenic Nonepileptic Seizures in Southwestern Germany
summary: This registry study is designed to characterize the longitudinal clinical course of patients with epilepsy and psychogenic nonepileptic seizures (PNES). A multidimensional assessment with follow-up evaluations over a five-year period will be conducted. Clinical data will be extracted from routine medical records. The study aims to identify factors associated with disease progression and clinical outcomes in order to improve the long-term management of these patients. No study-specific diagnostic or therapeutic procedures beyond standard clinical care will be performed.
conditions: Epilepsies (ICD-10: G40), psychogenic non-epileptic seizures (ICD-10: F44–45, F98), and syncope/faint (ICD-10: R55)
Other behavioural and emotional disorders with onset usually occurring in childhood and adolescence

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with a diagnosis of epilepsy or psychogenic nonepileptic seizures (PNES)
Written informed consent provided by the patient or, where applicable, by the patient's parent(s), legal guardian, or legally authorized representative.
Exclusion criteria:
Age <7 years
Patients unable to provide informed consent who do not have a legally authorized representative
